'''Hower Jerimott''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Behebothan]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Prosperity (Beheboth)|Prosperity]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Beheboth]].<ref name="bw" />

He performed the autopsy on [[Berl Matoone]] and filed a report stating he believed Matoone died from a massive cardiac failure due to catastrophic toxin levels in his body.<ref name="bw" />
